stem: A crop moves from a low-buffering substrate to one with substantially different cation-exchange behavior. How should the nutrient program be handled?
choices: Use the old program unchanged because media cannot affect nutrient behavior
Raise EC automatically to compensate for the higher exchange capacity
Treat the previous recipe as a starting point and validate root-zone pH/EC, plant response, and nutrient behavior in the new medium
Remove all micronutrients until the medium stabilizes
rationale: Media chemistry can change nutrient retention and buffering. A recipe that worked in one medium should be validated under the new root-zone conditions rather than assumed to transfer unchanged.
